results.title: Post-acquisition expansion with no stated plan to keep monitoring consistent
results.closest_fact_claim: In 2023, Americold acquired a 49% minority stake in RSA Cold Chain for $3.9 million, with immediate plans to expand locally, connect RSA to its global network, and pursue development opportunities across the Middle East and India, leveraging a concurrent partnership with DP World.

results.title: Quality certifications are periodic audits, not real-time compliance evidence
results.closest_fact_claim: RSA's own marketing claims an advanced WMS for real-time inventory visibility, continuous temperature monitoring, and a single-integration API for real-time inventory data.
